description: Prometheus /metrics at the ROOT path (excluded from /api/v1). Fase-0 M8 default-deny: the parity env sets no METRICS_TOKEN, so the endpoint answers 404 whatever the credentials. The 403/200 paths (Bearer + ?token=) are covered by internal/metrics tests; covering them here needs a per-file env (harness feature).

cases.name: metrics-disabled-404-with-api-token
cases.note: @Public: an API credential neither helps nor 401s
